set.body: Roadmap port/docs/roadmap.md P2.1. Input anchored source documents/rows and recorded typed proposals; deterministic source-only construction with entity/event/role/context evidence and per-row outcomes. Reuse admitted source text; no preassembled trusted source graph. Acceptance: independent saved source reused unchanged by two recalls, exact readback, unsupported/failed rows visible, foreign evidence and root-context promotion refused. Include scoped Scala caller/test inventory and compatibility decisions. No live provider required.
set.title: P2.1 Compile anchored source rows and recorded proposals into reusable source accounts
